payload.title: Publish go-diffutils' modules
payload.description: Publish go-diffutils' modules: settle its git and license state, add CI and a Release workflow, and ready each module for its first tag
payload.context:
Found 2026-10-26 while planning go-tealeaves E-2440 (from go-dt E-2431's session). go-tealeaves' teadiff module and several example modules require github.com/mikeschinkel/go-diffutils through `replace => ../go-diffutils`, so no go-tealeaves module builds for anyone but Mike, and E-2440 (no replace in publishable modules) cannot finish until go-diffutils is published. Mike asked for one task covering everything go-diffutils needs, not several.

State on 2026-10-26:
- The checkout is mid-rebase. Mike made a local initial commit (e05e63c), created the GitHub repo, which made its own initial commit (a2092d0: LICENSE and README.md), and pulling it conflicted in LICENSE. `git status` shows an interactive rebase of e05e63c onto a2092d0 stopped on that conflict, with every other file staged.
- Three modules: root (github.com/mikeschinkel/go-diffutils), dmp and sgdiff. dmp and sgdiff each require the root at v0.0.0 through `replace => ../`. No tags exist, no .github workflows, no justfile.
- Licensing. difflib.go holds code absorbed from github.com/pmezard/go-difflib, Copyright (c) 2013 Patrick Mezard, under the BSD 2-Clause license; its source keeps that copyright line. The local LICENSE is Mike's MIT license with the go-difflib notice and BSD 2-Clause text appended. dmp and sgdiff only import sergi/go-diff and sourcegraph/go-diff as module dependencies; no code from them is copied in. Mike intends MIT for his own code, is unsure how to credit absorbed BSD code within or beside a standard license, would switch the package to BSD 2-Clause if needed for compatibility, and wants help deciding.

Mike's words on scope: resolve all of go-diffutils' issues, add .github workflows, and publish released versions, ideally as one task. go-dt E-2431 is the model for a multi-module repo: no replace in publishable modules, an uncommitted generated go.work (`just work`), CI with GOWORK=off, and a Release workflow taking a module choice and making directory-prefixed tags (dmp/vX.Y.Z). The user makes the tags by running the workflow.

ops.statement: LICENSE holds Mike's MIT text followed by Patrick Mezard's go-difflib copyright line and the full BSD 3-Clause text, all three conditions included
difflib.go's header comment names BSD 3-Clause, keeps Mezard's copyright line and points to LICENSE
README.md lists the root, dmp and sgdiff modules, shows how to install each, has a Local Development section on just work and GOWORK=off, and has a License section crediting go-difflib
dmp/go.mod and sgdiff/go.mod have no replace directive and require root at a pseudo-version of a commit on main
ops.verify: go mod edit -json in each shows no Replace; go build and go test pass with GOWORK=off

ops.statement: Every go.mod is tidy with GOWORK=off
ops.verify: go mod tidy -diff reports nothing in root, dmp and sgdiff

ops.statement: A justfile offers help, work, ensure-valid, test, lint, fmt, vet, tidy, build, clean and ci, finding modules rather than listing them
just work writes a go.work over every module, and go.work and go.work.sum are ignored by git
.github/workflows/test.yml runs with GOWORK off, tests root, dmp and sgdiff, and checks every go.mod is tidy
.github/workflows/release.yml takes a module choice of root, dmp or sgdiff and makes vX.Y.Z for root and <dir>/vX.Y.Z for dmp and sgdiff
release.yml refuses a module whose declared path is wrong, whose go.mod has a replace, or whose tag already exists, and runs that module's tests with GOWORK off first
release.yml's notes list commits since that module's previous tag, limited to its directory for dmp and sgdiff, and excluding dmp, sgdiff and .endless for root
.endless/tasks holds Endless's _harness.sh and _guard.sh unchanged
After the land, root, dmp and sgdiff each have a v0.1.0 tag made by the Release workflow, and the Go proxy resolves each
After the root tag, pkg.go.dev shows root's documentation with its license recognised, or a follow-up task is filed to split Mezard's notice into its own file
Does not remove or merge the doterr.go copies in root and sgdiff
Does not change any exported identifier in root, dmp or sgdiff
Does not finish the paused rebase in the main checkout; Mike does that before spawning
doc.go's package comment names go-difflib's license as BSD 3-Clause, not MIT
difflib.go passes golangci-lint: WriteUnifiedDiff and WriteContextDiff return their final flush error, with tests proving it, and staticcheck's quick-fixes applied
difflib.go's header says Mike modified the absorbed code and summarises how
